summary: A Quote subscription on an NFO future: the detailed packet carries 12345675 open interest, which the web sends and the desktop's Quote frame drops.

deviations.reason: The desktop puts its mode label (ltp, quote, full) in data.mode; the Pocketful web adapter's frames carry its own. Follows each broker's own web adapter (lead rule 2026-11-09): set by the per-broker dialect switch in Phase B.

Pocketful sends the last trade time in epoch seconds; the web passes the seconds on as ltt (1762656900), the desktop sends epoch milliseconds (1762656900000), the unit the docs give every WebSocket time.

The desktop sends last_quantity beside last_trade_quantity; the Pocketful web adapter sends last_trade_quantity only, which is also the docs' name. Follows each broker's own web adapter (lead rule 2026-11-09): set by the per-broker dialect switch in Phase B.
deviations.ref: pocketful_adapter.py; docs/prompt/websockets-format.md (Quote); feed::dialect (per-broker switch, lane wire)

deviations.reason: The detailed packet carries the open interest (12345675) and the web's Quote frame sends it; the desktop's Quote frame leaves OI out, which the carrier work is to fix.
